<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Halfling Troublemaker](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3045)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

A halfling's bravado can sometimes lead them into trouble. These tricksters often roam in groups trying to one-up each other's last prank. While troublemakers rarely intend to kill, occasionally their pranks get out of hand.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47)): DC 15

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 13

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 10
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 1">[Halfling Troublemaker](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3045)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Small" />
<trait label="Humanoid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=628" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 192

**Perception** +10

**Languages**
[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Halfling](/Languages.aspx?ID=7)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +7, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +3, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +5, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +7, [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) +7

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +1

**Dex** +4

**Con** +1

**Int** +0

**Wis** +3

**Cha** +3
</row>

**Items**
[Filcher's Fork](/Weapons.aspx?ID=51), [Leather Armor](/Armor.aspx?ID=4)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 16 

**Fort** +4 

**Ref** +10 

**Will** +7 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 18

</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 30 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
filcher's fork +9 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Backstabber](/Traits.aspx?ID=172), [deadly d6](/Traits.aspx?ID=174), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [thrown 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=195)),
**Damage** 1d4+1 piercing

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
filcher's fork +9 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Backstabber](/Traits.aspx?ID=172), [deadly d6](/Traits.aspx?ID=174), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [thrown 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=195)),
**Damage** 1d4+1 piercing

**Graffiti Egg** <actions string="Single Action" />  the halfling troublemaker throws an egg filled with paint, glitter, and confetti at a creature within 30 feet. The target must succeed a DC 17 Reflex saving throw or become [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65) for 1 round (or 1 minute on a critical failure).

**Keen Eyes**   The halfling gains a +2 circumstance bonus when using the [Seek](/Actions.aspx?ID=2301) action to find [hidden](/Conditions.aspx?ID=79) or [undetected](/Conditions.aspx?ID=96) creatures within 30 feet of you. Whenever the halfling targets a creature that is [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) or hidden from them, reduce the DC of the flat check to 3 for a concealed target or 9 for a hidden one.

**[Sneak Attack](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=34)**   The troublemaker deals an extra 1d6 precision damage to [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) creatures.

</column>
